_fixture: what scan-page.js produces for tests/fixtures/hostile/forms/consent-decoupled.html, AS OF the labelExact vouch (commit 5a1d8b2 + w2-engine's scan-page.js change).
_labelExact: g1 has NO labelExact: its label comes from an aria-label, and an attribute is not text the user can read, so an attribute can never establish exactness. g2/g3/g4 have labelExact:true and their `l` is UNTRUNCATED — which is what makes g2 and g3 distinguishable again. Before the vouch they both sliced to the same 120 characters and the allowlist could not tell a certification from a jury-trial waiver.
_forged: A page-supplied scanner can put labelExact:true on anything (see tests/security/rce-round-trip.test.mjs). This fixture is what the REAL scanner produces; the forged variant is constructed inside the test that needs it.
